verse.verse_3: And the Even and the Odd,
verse.verse_4: And the night when it departeth,
verse.verse_5: There surely is an oath for thinking man.
verse.verse_6: Dost thou not consider how thy Lord dealt with (the tribe of) A'ad,
verse.verse_8: The like of which was not created in the lands;
verse.verse_9: And with (the tribe of) Thamud, who clove the rocks in the valley;
verse.verse_10: And with Pharaoh, firm of might,
verse.verse_11: Who (all) were rebellious (to Allah) in these lands,
verse.verse_13: Therefore thy Lord poured on them the disaster of His punishment.
verse.verse_14: Lo! thy Lord is ever watchful.
verse.verse_15: As for man, whenever his Lord trieth him by honouring him, and is gracious unto him, he saith: My Lord honoureth me.
verse.verse_16: But whenever He trieth him by straitening his means of life, he saith: My Lord despiseth me.
verse.verse_17: Nay, but ye (for your part) honour not the orphan
verse.verse_18: And urge not on the feeding of the poor.
verse.verse_19: And ye devour heritages with devouring greed.
verse.verse_20: And love wealth with abounding love.
verse.verse_21: Nay, but when the earth is ground to atoms, grinding, grinding,
verse.verse_22: And thy Lord shall come with angels, rank on rank,
verse.verse_23: And hell is brought near that day; on that day man will remember, but how will the remembrance (then avail him)?
verse.verse_24: He will say: Ah, would that I had sent before me (some provision) for my life!
verse.verse_25: None punisheth as He will punish on that day!
verse.verse_26: None bindeth as He then will bind.
verse.verse_27: But ah! thou soul at peace!
verse.verse_28: Return unto thy Lord, content in His good pleasure!
